title: tetradenia baueri
intro: Tetradenia baueri, commonly known as "Kakamega Orange", is a plant species native to East Africa. It has been reported to possess various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in treating conditions such as fever, cough, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Tetradenia baueri include its ability to act as an expectorant, anti-diarrheal, and anti-microbial agent. Bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids, diterpenoids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
